messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (1)
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar.
Your letter of 2026-07-06 (doc:20260706-70710-M1) says your material is covered until March 2027.
We accept the AS-14404 index clause on the material share with a 5% deadband; the attached base price reflects the price risk this removes for you.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 94,800 kg per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (1)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We welcome your commitment to a 24-month contract and the inclusion of the AS-14404 index clause. 

Currently, our offer stands at a price of €5.69 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

As an alternative, based on these terms and a 60-day payment period, we can offer a revised price of €5.65 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

To fully consider your projected volume of 94,800 kg per year, please share the underlying forecast data. Which volume can you commit to? Please note that material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Dear customer,

We appreciate your revised offer and your continued commitment to a 36-month contract with 60-day payment terms. As your reliable partner with an extensive range of high-quality materials and dedicated distributor service, we always strive to find the right solution for you. In response to your movement, we are prepared to lower our price to €5.54 per unit. This offer represents a further concession on our part to support our long-term partnership.
